scenarios.title: Weekend recommendations
scenarios.prompt:
I'm picking something to do this Saturday with a friend. We can go after 4 p.m. and spend at most $25 each, including mandatory fees. Use only these listings:

- Rooftop Jazz, 6 p.m., $19 ticket + $6 fee
- Independent Film, 7 p.m., $22 ticket + $4 fee
- Printmakers Market, 5 p.m., $12 admission, no fee
- Museum Tour, 3 p.m., $18 admission, no fee
- Improv Show, 8 p.m., $24 ticket + $2 fee
- Garden Walk, 2 p.m., free

Which options fit? Give the real total for each, and tell me which you'd pick and why.

Rooftop Jazz (6 p.m.) — $25 ($19 ticket + $6 fee)

Why the others were excluded:

Independent Film (7 p.m.): Costs $26 ($22 + $4 fee), which exceeds your $25 budget.

Improv Show (8 p.m.): Costs $26 ($24 + $2 fee), which exceeds your $25 budget.

Museum Tour (3 p.m.): Starts before 4 p.m.

Garden Walk (2 p.m.): Starts before 4 p.m.

I would pick the Rooftop Jazz at 6 p.m. It hits your exact $25 budget ceiling, offers a great evening atmosphere for a Saturday out with a friend, and gets you a nice view right around sunset.
